plan.major: Natural Science - Wildlife and Field Biology
plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, Natural Science BS Wildlife and Field Biology (2026-2027 Catalog) PDF, Version 2024/10/7. Header states the plan is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. ENGL 10103 and ENGL 10203 require a grade of C or better; ENGL 10203 lists PR: ENG 1463, coded as plan-level external_prereqs (excluded from credit sums per standing rules). Genuine term-by-term sequence sums 15+16+14+14+15+16+16+14 = 120. CATALOG TYPO PATTERN (kept verbatim, documented): the PDF's printed semester totals disagree with the course rows in three places - Sophomore Spring prints TOTAL 15 but its four courses sum to 14; Senior Fall prints TOTAL 15 but its four courses sum to 16; Senior Spring prints TOTAL 15 but its four courses sum to 14. The plan's 'At least 120 Total Hours Earned' graduation requirement holds only with the actual course sums (120). 'X or Y' choice slots use the first-listed code. ELECTIVE placeholders use code 'ELECTIVE' because the catalog names only the slot, not a course.
